meta.title: tashrif.info — Modern website analytics
meta.description: Privacy-friendly web analytics for visitors, sessions, pages, and countries. A React layout component, a live dashboard, and Telegram reports — connect in a few lines of code.
meta.keywords: web analytics, website stats, visitors, tashrif.info, Next.js analytics, Telegram reports, privacy analytics, Uzbekistan analytics
meta.loginDescription: Sign in to the tashrif.info dashboard with Google. Manage visits, pages, logs, and Telegram reports.
meta.demoDescription: Try the tashrif.info demo: traffic, pages, countries, and logs. Explore the analytics board without signing up.

hero.headline: See every visit. Ship better products.
hero.sub: Users, pageviews, countries, and pages — add one React component and a public client ID.

steps.title: How it works
steps.sub: Domain, client ID, then a live board — three steps.

one.title: Add a domain
one.desc: Sign in with Google, create a domain in the dashboard — you get a client ID for tracking.

two.title: Add the tracker
two.desc: Install the tashrif npm package and add <Tashrif /> from tashrif/react to your root layout.

three.title: Watch traffic
three.desc: Traffic, pages, and logs land on the board live. Telegram reports are optional.

metricsSection.title: Metrics that matter
metricsSection.sub: The same numbers as on the board — without the clutter.

preview.title: Live preview
preview.sub: A snapshot of what your board looks like.

intro.title: See your site’s traffic on one clear board
intro.body: tashrif.info is lightweight web analytics for visitors, pages, and sources. Your data, your panel — not a heavy ad tracker.
intro.boardDesc: Map and chart, which paths hold people, each pageview: path, country, IP, user-agent.
intro.reportsDesc: Daily, weekly, or monthly. Stats as text; logs and traffic as PDF. Sent at 06:00 Tashkent for the previous period.
intro.teamDesc: Owner, admin, and viewer — each person gets the right access.

why.title: Why tashrif.info
why.sdkDesc: Set NEXT_PUBLIC_TASHRIF_CLIENT_ID and render <Tashrif /> — visits are written to the board.
why.telegramDesc: At 06:00 Tashkent, the previous day, week, or month. No need to open the dashboard.
why.localeDesc: UI and reports follow your account language — Uzbek or English.
why.teamDesc: Viewers see analytics. Admins manage reports and access. Owners run everything.

closing.title: Connect your first domain today
closing.sub: Open the demo or add your site — it takes a few minutes.

footer.tagline: Web analytics that makes site visits easy to see.

login.title: Welcome back
login.sub: Sign in with Google to open your dashboard.
